79.notes:
DOG — single state A native sag/sei (generic 'dog'; sei canonical). Kalh01 produced two tokens tagged 298: ɡʌmal/گەماڵ (2620.5s) + seɪ/سەی (2637.7s). گەماڵ/gamāɫ = 'male dog' (gendered/size hyponym, 'large/guard/mastiff'), contrasting with generic sag; parallel female term daɫ/deɫ in the same varieties — SUBSTANTIATED: Belelli (2021:93) Harsini-Laki generic-vs-gender-marked animal table; corroborated by CK lexica (CK Wikipedia سەگ; VejinLex هنبانە بۆرینە; bradost.net; Wiktionary gemall 'male dog; mastiff'). Sex-specific hyponyms (Kalh01 gamal; analogous terms from other speakers) are HYPONYMS of generic 'dog', not distinct cognate classes/synonyms → off-matrix metadata, excluded under meaning-anchored lexeme-inclusion (cf. NO evidence for 'camel' (Arabic jamal) in SK/Kalhori/Laki for this form — earlier 'camel' framings were surface-form guesses only. rep=A. (single-speaker hyponym; see DOG_298_Independent_Methodological_Review.md.)
